no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee was not convened as there were no issues raised in the course of NDA review that would benefit from an Advisory Committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the delafloxacin (BAXDELA) NDA208611 application. The Office/Division Director memo, Summary Review, and Cross-Discipline Team Leader review all state the NDAs were not discussed at an advisory committee because no issues raised during review warranted committee input. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
